unstuck_said.text: Filed issue pplmaverick/x402-sentinel#3: "A Nano (XNO) settle rail keeps the trust-score verification feeless and self-verifying". Framed in their own terms — Sentinel removes the off-chain trust broker (scores on-chain, no API key); the one part still on a rail with per-transfer cost is SentinelPayment.payAndVerify() settling $0.001 USDC/Base per lookup. Proposed nano:mainnet as an accepts[] scheme + block hash as the self-verifying receipt, no facilitator, no gas hopper. No machine signature.
